est_description.message: Replaces personal data with labels before messages go to AI services and restores it in answers. Works with Omissis on your PC.

suspended_icon.message: Omissis: protection paused in this browser

icon_not_connected.message: Omissis: not connected to the program

icon_not_responding.message: Omissis: the program is not responding

fault_not_connected.message: The extension is not connected to the program.

fault_code.message: The connection code is no longer valid: reconnect it from the panel.

fault_program.message: The protection program is not responding: start it from the icon next to the clock.

fault_outdated.message: This extension is still an earlier version: restart the browser, or reload it from the extensions page.

connect_help.message: To connect it, open the program's panel, Connections section, and press "Connect this browser". Or paste here the code shown by the panel.

site_outside_catalog.message: not an AI service in the catalogue

option_notices.message: Show a notice on the page when I replace data

managed_note.message: Rule set by your organisation: suspending does not apply on this site.

welcome_title.message: Omissis is installed in this browser

welcome_below.message: It replaces personal data in your messages to AI services before they leave, and puts it back in the answers. It works together with the Omissis program on this PC: until it is connected, on protected services messages are not sent.

welcome_to_connect.message: One step left: connect it to the program

welcome_connected.message: Connected: you are protected in this browser

welcome_step_program.message: Open Omissis on this PC (the icon next to the clock). If you do not have it yet, install it: the extension alone is not enough.

welcome_step_connect.message: Press the button below: the Omissis panel opens and connects by itself.

welcome_step_use.message: Go back to your chats: there is nothing else to do.

welcome_done.message: You can close this tab. The Omissis icon next to the address bar shows what is happening on the open site.

blocked_text.message: Using this AI service is not allowed by the Omissis settings on this computer.

blocked_ask.message: If you need it for work, ask whoever manages the system.

notice_press_enter.message: Data replaced in the message box: press Enter again to send the message.

box_notice.message: Message not sent: I cannot replace the data in the message box.

attachment_text.message: PDFs and images became text files.

attachment_blocked.message: "$1" cannot be anonymised: it was not attached.

engine_notice.message: Message not sent: the protection program is not responding. Start it and try again.

notice_not_connected.message: Message not sent: the extension is not connected to the program. Open the panel and press "Connect this browser".

file_notice.message: File upload blocked by the settings.

reload_notice.message: The extension has been updated: reload the page before writing.

extension_notice.message: Message not sent: the extension cannot protect it.

gone_notice.message: Omissis is off and no longer protects this window. To send anyway, do it again: it will leave unprotected.

page_reload_notice.message: Omissis has restarted: reload the window before writing (Ctrl+R, Cmd+R on a Mac).
